R01.name: 爆发扭胯
R01.description: 左扭胯→右扭胯→下蹲→站起
R01.prompt_injection: explosive hip thrust left then right, squat down and rise, powerful pelvis isolation move

R02.name: 水蛇后背摇
R02.description: 背对镜头→脊柱波浪→转身回头
R02.prompt_injection: back to camera, full spine body wave from tailbone to shoulders, slow sensual turn to face camera with eye contact

R03.name: 力量HipHop
R03.description: 胸部震动→滑步→极速定格
R03.prompt_injection: chest pop and lock, moonwalk slide step sideways, sudden freeze pose with arms extended, hip-hop power move

R04.name: 甜美手势舞
R04.description: 比心→指向镜头→双手框脸→wink
R04.prompt_injection: finger heart gesture, pointing directly at camera lens, framing face with both hands, playful wink

R05.name: 慵懒摇摆
R05.description: 左右慵懒摇摆→手臂自然垂荡→微笑
R05.prompt_injection: lazy side-to-side body sway, arms hanging loose and natural, relaxed gentle smile, effortless groove

R06.name: 拉丁扭腰
R06.description: 快速 8 字扭腰→提膝→甩发
R06.prompt_injection: fast figure-eight hip rotation, knee lift alternating left and right, dramatic hair toss to the side, Latin dance energy

R07.name: 韩舞精华
R07.prompt_injection: smooth arm wave flowing from fingertips, full body roll from head to hips, sharp freeze in idol pose with confident gaze

R08.name: 街头 Bounce
R08.description: 弹跳律动→左右交叉步→收势比耶
R08.prompt_injection: bouncing to the beat with bent knees, cross-step shuffle left and right, finishing with peace sign pose and wide grin

R09.name: 科目三标准序列
R09.description: 重心下沉→骨盆画圈→膝盖微颤→左右甩发→手腕翻转→单脚滑步
R09.prompt_injection: weight sinking low, pelvis drawing slow circles, knees trembling rhythmically, hair swaying left and right, wrist flip and flick, smooth one-foot glide step sideways

R10.name: 汉服袖舞
R10.description: 抛袖→旋转→水袖飘动→定格亮相
R10.prompt_injection: tossing wide hanfu sleeves outward, elegant full spin with sleeves trailing through the air, flowing sleeve wave ripple, dramatic still pose aiming at audience
